review_candidates.title: Senior Oracle ERP Specialist
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior Oracle ERP Specialist Location: United Arab Emirates (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Work Arrangement: 100% Remote — Work From Home Level: Senior About the Role We are seeking an experienced Senior Oracle ERP Specialist to support the administration, optimization, configuration oversight, and continuous improvement of enterprise resource planning systems. This fully remote role focuses on Oracle ERP functional and technical support, business process analysis, system integration coordination, data quality monitoring, and the delivery of reliable ERP solutions aligned with organizational requirements. The successful candidate will collaborate with finance, procurement, supply chain, human resources, IT, and business stakeholders to translate operational requirements into effective system solutions. The role involves remote system analysis, configuration documentation review, issue investigation, testing coordination, reporting, and user support across Oracle ERP environments. Key Responsibilities Provide senior-level remote functional and technical support for Oracle ERP applications and related enterprise systems. Review and analyze business requirements, workflows, and operational processes to identify ERP improvement opportunities. Support configuration analysis and documentation across relevant Oracle ERP modules, including Financials, Procurement, Projects, Supply Chain, Inventory, and Human Capital Management, as applicable. Coordinate requirements gathering, solution design discussions, and functional specifications with business and technical stakeholders. Review system configurations, approval workflows, business rules, and application settings through authorized access and documented procedures. Support incident investigation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution coordination for Oracle ERP issues. Assist with system enhancements, change requests, release planning, and application lifecycle management. Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), regression testing, integration testing, and validation of proposed system changes. Review data migration plans, data mapping documentation, reconciliation results, and master data quality reports. Support integrations between Oracle ERP and other enterprise applications, reporting platforms, and third-party systems. Develop and maintain functional documentation, configuration records, process maps, test scripts, and user guides. Analyze ERP reports and dashboards to identify transaction discrepancies, process inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation. Provide remote training, guidance, and functional support to end users and departmental key users. Monitor system performance reports and coordinate technical investigation with infrastructure, database, and application support teams. Support access governance, segregation of duties reviews, and compliance with established ERP security procedures. Coordinate with vendors, implementation partners, and internal IT teams on technical issues and enhancement activities. Contribute to ERP optimization initiatives, process standardization, and continuous improvement projects. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related discipline. Significant professional experience supporting, implementing, configuring, or optimizing Oracle ERP environments. Strong understanding of Oracle ERP Cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP) and/or Oracle E-Business Suite. Experience with relevant Oracle modules such as General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Inventory, Order Management, Projects, or HCM. Knowledge of ERP business processes, application architecture, workflow configuration, and enterprise system integrations. Experience preparing functional specifications, test scenarios, process documentation, and user training materials. Familiarity with Oracle reporting and analytics tools, OTBI, BI Publisher, SQL, and relevant data analysis techniques. Understanding of data migration, reconciliation, master data management, and system validation processes. Knowledge of ERP security roles, user access controls, segregation of duties, and change management practices. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate distributed teams in a fully remote environment. Relevant Oracle certifications or implementation training are advantageous. What We Offer A fully remote, work-from-home position based in the UAE employment context. Opportunities to contribute to enterprise technology transformation and ERP optimization initiatives. Exposure to complex Oracle ERP environments and cross-functional business processes. A collaborative, digitally enabled working environment. Opportunities for professional development and advanced Oracle technology training. The opportunity to improve system reliability, business process efficiency, and enterprise data quality. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit an updated CV outlining their Oracle ERP experience, implementation or support projects, functional module expertise, technical capabilities, and relevant certifications. Include examples of system enhancements, integration projects, process improvements, or ERP optimization initiatives where appropriate. Application Subject: Application – Senior Oracle ERP Specialist (UAE Remote) Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer. System access and change authority: This role provides remote ERP analysis, functional support, configuration documentation review, testing coordination, reporting, and technical recommendations. Physical server and network inspections, hardware installation, equipment replacement, and data center maintenance must be performed by qualified local IT personnel. Production deployments, privileged access assignments, financial configuration approvals, changes affecting live business transactions, data migration authorization, security exceptions, formal system certifications, regulatory submissions, and statutory or professional sign-offs must be performed or approved by appropriately authorized system owners, finance leaders, IT security personnel, and compliance professionals in accordance with organizational change-control procedures.
